verdict.rationale: Offloading large models to a hosted cloud tier is a fair question for a model-serving engine, since comparable local runners can offer such a tier. Nothing in the evidence shows vLLM providing a hosted cloud tier or remote execution without downloading weights. Quantization, which lets large models fit smaller devices, and multi-GPU parallelism are adjacent capabilities that still run on the user's own hardware, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
